parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id, password_hash, locked_until, failed_login_attempts
  FROM users WHERE email = $1::text
), state AS (
  SELECT id, failed_login_attempts AS fails,
         (locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until > now()) AS locked,
         (password_hash = crypt($2::text, password_hash)) AS ok
  FROM target
), dummy AS (
  -- inconnu : on calcule quand même un hash pour que le temps de réponse ne révèle rien
  SELECT crypt($2::text, gen_salt('bf', 12)) AS h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
), bump AS (
  UPDATE users u SET
    failed_login_attempts = CASE WHEN s.locked THEN u.failed_login_attempts
                                 WHEN s.ok THEN 0
                                 ELSE u.failed_login_attempts + 1 END,
    locked_until = CASE WHEN s.locked THEN u.locked_until
                        WHEN s.ok THEN NULL
                        WHEN u.failed_login_attempts + 1 >= 5 THEN now() + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
                        ELSE u.locked_until END
  FROM state s WHERE u.id = s.id
  RETURNING u.id
), sess AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (chat_session_id, user_id)
  SELECT $3::text, s.id FROM state s WHERE s.ok AND NOT s.locked
  ON CONFLICT (chat_session_id) DO UPDATE
    SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, created_at = now(), expires_at = now() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
  RETURNING chat_session_id
), clear_pending AS (
  DELETE FROM auth_pending WHERE chat_session_id = $3::text AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess)
), log_known AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (event, user_id, details)
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.locked THEN 'login_blocked'
              WHEN s.ok THEN 'login_ok'
              WHEN s.fails + 1 >= 5 THEN 'account_locked'
              ELSE 'login_failed' END,
         s.id, '{}'::jsonb
  FROM state s
), log_unknown AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (event, details)
  SELECT 'login_failed_unknown', '{}'::jsonb WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM state WHERE ok AND NOT locked) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'denied' END AS status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dummy) AS _pad;

assignments.name: output
assignments.value: ={{ $json.status === 'ok' ? "Connexion réussie ✅ Que souhaitez-vous modifier : centres d'intérêt, horaires d'envoi, email, ton, format ? (tapez « aide » pour la liste)." : "Identifiants invalides, ou compte temporairement verrouillé (15 minutes après 5 échecs)." }}

parameters.query:
WITH s AS (
  UPDATE sessions
  SET expires_at = LEAST(created_at + INTERVAL '8 hours', now() + INTERVAL '2 hours')
  WHERE chat_session_id = $1::text
    AND expires_at > now()
    AND created_at + INTERVAL '8 hours' > now()
  RETURNING user_id
)
-- toujours une ligne : utilisateur connecté (ou NULL) + étape guidée en cours (10 min max)
SELECT (SELECT user_id FROM s) AS user_id, p.step, p.email
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one
LEFT JOIN auth_pending p ON p.chat_session_id = $1::text AND p.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes';

parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE auth_pending SET step = $3::text, email = lower(btrim($2::text)), created_at = now()
  WHERE chat_session_id = $1::text
    AND length(btrim($2::text)) <= 254
    AND lower(btrim($2::text)) ~ '^[a-z0-9._%+-]{1,64}@[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)*\.[a-z]{2,}$'
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd) AS ok;

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_pretty(jsonb_build_object(
  'email', u.email,
  'compte_cree_le', u.created_at,
  'consentement', jsonb_build_object('date', u.consent_given_at, 'version', u.consent_version),
  'preferences', to_jsonb(p) - 'user_id',
  'newsletters_recues', (SELECT count(*) FROM sent_newsletters s WHERE s.user_id = u.id),
  'feedbacks', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', f.created_at, 'message', f.message))
                         FROM feedback f WHERE f.user_id = u.id), '[]'::jsonb)
)) AS data
FROM users u JOIN preferences p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.id = $1::uuid;
